events.text: Battle of Stirling Bridge: William Wallace's Scots defeat the English army.
Henry Hudson reaches the island of Manhattan.
Alexander Hamilton becomes the first U.S. Secretary of the Treasury.
Mahatma Gandhi launches the Satyagraha movement of non-violent protest in Johannesburg.
A military coup in Chile overthrows President Salvador Allende.
Pete Rose breaks Ty Cobb's record for career hits in baseball.
Scotland votes in a referendum to establish its own parliament.
NASA's Mars Global Surveyor reaches orbit around Mars.
The September 11 attacks kill nearly 3,000 people in the United States.

deaths.text: Muhammad Ali Jinnah, founder of Pakistan
